title: Hinton asks about Wilson's right-hand fingering
summary: Wilson says he plays by ear and uses all his fingers.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: That's cute. Now there's just one other thing I'd like to ask you about, that I've been inquisitive about, over a period of watching you play, I see that you favor one finger on your right hand. Why do you do that?
I don't really know; I just play by ear -- I play any kind of way to get the idea out. Whatever I do ...
But it seems like there's one finger that you don't use at all.
I guess I just never noticed you using that one.
It depends on what I'm playing, see.
I use my index finger to play, I use them all!
No, not that one, this one.
Oh, for certain things, I use that one, too.
